messages.content: Hi! How can I help you today?

Hey there! I could use a hand with an order I placed recently. My work-from-home dreams just got crushed—turns out, I’ll be back in the office sooner than expected. Is there a way to return just the home office stuff from my order and keep the hiking gear? Also, I’d love to know how much I’d get back if that’s possible.

I’m sorry that happened! I can help with a **partial return** (returning only the home-office items and keeping the hiking gear) *if the order is already marked as delivered*.

First, I need to authenticate your account. Please reply with **one** of the following:
1) **Your email address** used at checkout, **or**
2) Your **first name + last name + ZIP code**

Also, please share your **order id** (it looks like `#W0000000`) or tell me the exact items you consider “home office stuff” so I can check whether a partial return is possible and what the refund would be.

Sure thing! My name’s Noah Patel and my ZIP code is 10108. I don’t remember my order ID off the top of my head, and honestly, I can’t recall exactly what the home office items were—I just know I ordered three of them along with some hiking stuff. Is there a way you can look up my order with my name and ZIP? Sorry, my brain’s been a bit scrambled with all these changes!
